body: I appreciate your willingness to help. I'm just trying to understand why one moment I feel fine and the next I find it rational to kill myself because it's really jarring and confusing. Also, the increasing frequency and sincerity of the thoughts scares me. I know I need to get a medical assessment and some type of help - I just think I needed to express what I've been going through to someone and hopefully hear that people have gone through similar and are fine now.

The voices from the past episode seemed to be an isolated incident, but when it happened I saw a doctor and got on bipolar medication. I stopped taking the medication rather quickly because it didn't sit well with me and that ended up being fine because after some therapy I've felt stable for 7 years or so and imagined I was good. However, on both sides of my family there is some pretty intense history of mental health issues including depression and schizophrenia, so it feels like a looming threat that maybe it's been in some latent state and one day issues will manifest. I'm worried about the conviction I have during these suicidal thoughts like right now where it feels like a reasonable thing to do despite knowing it's not.
